title: Polish the schedule page for mobile

criteria.text: C1 Carousel (phone): each date reached with Next or swipe opens with its first time slot showing, not a closed header over a blank screen. Unit test RED then GREEN. Before and after pictures. The stacked list on desktop is unchanged.
criteria.evidence: Unit test RED on the old code: 2 failed and 14 passed (build/U1-RED.txt); GREEN 16 of 16 (build/U1-GREEN.txt). The reviewer re-proved it fails on the old file. My browser checks A0 to A2 at 390, 360 and 430: after Next once and twice the date shows cards and a time group (8, 8 and 4 card markers). Picture after/states-390/07-carousel-next.png. The desktop stacked list is unchanged (builder and reviewer checked).

criteria.text: C2 Search box: 44 px tall at 360, 390 and 430, text 16 px on phones, border at least 3:1 against its background (the project 3:1 rule). The desktop row still fits. Measured before and after.
criteria.evidence: Measured by me in the browser (inputs probe): 44 px tall at 360 and 390, 16 px text on phones (14 px on desktop), border 3.29 dark, 3.52 light, 3.49 winter against the field (before: 36 px, 14 px, 1.34, 1.23, 1.47). The box and the calendar button now share rows y 164 to 208. Desktop gets a 44 px box and a darker border, as planned; it is the only desktop change.

criteria.text: C3 Timeslots tab: the time header band and the team tiles line up with the card edge, and the tiles are wider so names are cut less. Measured offsets and pictures before and after. Desktop looks right.
criteria.evidence: Pictures before and after at 360 (I looked at them): before, the band was inset and Fake Team Alpha wrapped to two lines; after, the band reaches the card edge and the tiles are wider. Builder measured the band from x 29-361 to 5-385 at 390 and 0 differing pixels on desktop; the reviewer swapped the old padding back in at 1280 and 768 and found 0 differing pixels.

criteria.text: C4 A search with no hits shows No matches for the text and a Clear search button that empties the search. The chip and My team empty message and the Timeslots empty message do not change. Unit tests RED then GREEN, plus a real-browser picture.
criteria.evidence: Unit tests RED on the old code: 5 failed and 79 passed (build/U4-RED.txt); GREEN 84 of 84. The reviewer re-proved they fail on the old code. My browser checks B1 to B9 at 390, 360 and 430: No matches with the Nothing matches text and a Clear search button that empties the box and brings the list back; no Check back soon; a chip plus a search shows the chip message; the Timeslots tab ignores the search; the Completed tab says No matches too; a 40-letter word does not scroll the page sideways. Picture after/states-390/09-search-no-results.png.

criteria.text: C5 Calendar: the pop-up closes when a date is picked (unit test RED then GREEN, and in the browser). The month arrows sit inside the pop-up in line with the month name. The shared calendar component file is not edited.
criteria.evidence: Unit tests RED on the old code: 3 failed and 8 passed (build/U5-RED.txt); GREEN 11 of 11. My browser checks C0 to C6 at 390, 360 and 430: picking a day closes the pop-up, clicking the selected day closes it, Escape and a press outside still close it, the month arrows are level with the caption (y 255 and 255) and inside the pop-up (pop-up top 212, arrow top 233). The shared ui/calendar.tsx is not in the diff.

criteria.text: C6 Keyboard: the pager dots and Next scroll clear of the sticky tab bar, and the date strip focus ring is at least 3:1 against its background in dark, light and winter. Measured.
criteria.evidence: PARTLY MET, said plainly. Focus ring (met): measured by me, the ring against the page is 10.0 to 10.3 dark, 4.7 light, 7.6 to 8.0 winter (before about 2.2). Pager (partly met): scroll-mt-16 keeps the pager clear when the browser has to scroll to it (builder, real Tab presses on a tall night: pager at y 64-108 with 0 px hidden, before 44 px hidden). On the natural Tab path from the tab panel to Next the reviewer found Next still lands 21 of 44 px under the 60 px bar, the same with the class removed. No class-only fix exists. Left alone and reported to Doug.

criteria.text: C7 Contrast of 12 px text: the winner name is at least 4.5:1 in light, and the FINAL pill is at least 4.5:1 in dark, light and winter. Measured before and after in all three themes.
criteria.evidence: Measured by me with the contrast scan in dark, light and winter at 390 and dark and light at 360: no failing line for the FINAL pill, the winner name or any other 12 px text. Builder numbers: FINAL pill dark 3.61 and 3.85 to 7.08 and 7.53, light 4.49 to 5.93, winter 6.92 to 5.53 (still passes); winner name light 3.65 to 5.36. The scan lines that remain are decorative (score dash, calendar outside days) or a scanner artifact on a gradient band (white text on navy; I looked at the picture).

criteria.text: C8 The Swipe to see more dates hint no longer pulses and stays at least 4.5:1. The global loading pulse rule in index.css is not touched.
criteria.evidence: Measured by me: the hint has opacity 1 and animation none in dark, light and winter (six samples over two seconds each). The contrast scan lists no failure for it. index.css is not in the diff.

criteria.text: C9 Tap targets on phones: the time-group header buttons are 44 px tall, and the All and Int chips are at least 44 px wide. Desktop sizes do not change. Measured.
criteria.evidence: Measured by me at 390 and 360: time-group headers 358x44 and 328x44 (were 36 high); the All and Int chips are 44 wide (were 41); the search box is 44 high. Desktop: my pixel diff of the chips row at 1280 shows 0 differing pixels (min-w-11 md:min-w-0 keeps the chips as they were), and the header keeps md:min-h-0.

criteria.text: C10 Date dots row with 19 nights (long scenario): Previous and Next stay on screen at 360 and 390 px. Picture before and after.
criteria.evidence: My checks D1 to D4 with the long-season mock: 19 nights at 390 shows 1 of 19 with no dots and Next at x 342-386 of 390; at 360 Next sits at x 312-356 of 360; 10 nights at 430 Next sits at x 382-426. Before: Next at x 504-548 with 19 nights (off screen).

criteria.text: C11 No new console errors and no sideways scroll at 360, 390, 430 and desktop 1280, in dark, light and winter. Nothing else on the page moved: I compared the before and after pictures myself.
criteria.evidence: My runs on the final code: no console errors and no sideways scroll at 360, 390 and 430 (main, heavy and empty scenarios) and desktop 1280 (shoot report: consoleErrors and overflow empty). The error scenario logs only the app own report of the fake 500, the same as before. Nothing else moved: my pixel diffs against the before pictures show 0 differing pixels in the date strip chips area and in both 8 px edge bands at 390 and 360, and 0 in the desktop date strip and chips rows; the only desktop change is the search box row. Light and winter were scanned for contrast and screenshotted; the reviewer checked overflow and the empty and counter states in light and winter.

criteria.text: C12 All required repo checks and the factory-specs check pass on the final commit. Docs changed in the same change: the schedule page doc, the verification rows and the totals. A fresh independent code review approves. Left alone and reported: load jump, reaction button width, long-name clamp, the 14 date-strip tab stops, shared calendar cells and arrows, theme toggle size.
criteria.evidence: All six required checks pass at cfeeaac (integrity, typecheck, lint, knip, build, unit: 825 files and 7513 tests) and the factory-specs check passes. Docs changed in the same commits: the page doc and rows SCHED-08, 17, 19 and 29 (rewritten, no row added, so the totals stay). Fresh independent reviews: APPROVE at 73e0e2b (one SHOULD, fixed afterwards) and APPROVE on the last change cfeeaac. Left alone: load jump, reaction button width, long-name clamp, the 14 date-strip tab stops, shared calendar cells and arrows and the admin date pickers (same arrow bug), theme toggle size, the 43 px team links and the prediction toggle in shared match cards, the focus ring cut on the outer side of the first and last date chip.

criteria.text: C13 Date dots: with 9 dates or fewer the dots look and tap as today (24 px wide); with more than 9 dates text like 3 of 19 replaces them and updates on Next and Previous. Unit tests for 9 dates, 10 dates and Next.
criteria.evidence: Unit tests RED on the old code: 2 failed and 6 passed (build/U12-RED.txt); GREEN 8 of 8. My checks D1 to D4: 9 nights shows 9 dots and no counter; 10 and 19 nights show n of N and no dots; Next moves 1 of 19 to 2 of 19. The dots are still 24 px wide up to 9 dates.

criteria.text: C14 Search ignores spaces at the start and end: alpha with a trailing or leading space finds the same matches as alpha, spaces alone show the whole list like an empty box, and a space inside the text still counts. Unit tests RED then GREEN, a real-browser check, and the page doc and the verification row are updated.
criteria.evidence: Unit tests RED on the old filter: useScheduleFiltering.test.tsx 3 failed (trailing space, leading space, spaces alone) and 4 passed (build/C14-RED.txt); GREEN 7 of 7. My browser checks B5, B5b and B5c at 390, 360 and 430: spaces alone show the whole list; kilo plus a space and a space plus kilo both find the same 2 matches as kilo; zzzz plus a space shows No matches and echoes zzzz. The delta reviewer also tried non-breaking space, tab and full-width space. The page doc and row SCHED-19 are updated and the old edge-case note is removed.

reviews.summary: Independent plan review: CHANGES, all accepted and the plan revised. Blockers: (U4) ScheduleContent has no search text, so a search prop and a clear callback are passed from Schedule.tsx, and chips win over search; (U12) narrowing the dots breaks the 24 px floor, so it went to Doug, who chose text after 9 dates. Also fixed in the plan: U1 test mock cannot see isFirstGroup, U6 needs exact classes and no edit to the shared calendar, U10 ring may vanish on the selected chip in light, U5 needs open plus onOpenChange and the undefined date, desktop effect of U2 and U3 stated (U3 kept desktop-identical), U8 old value stated, docs list completed (SCHED-19 rewritten).

Fresh independent reviewer on 73e0e2b: APPROVE, no blockers, one SHOULD. It proved every new test fails on the old code (carousel open, search empty state, calendar close, date counter) and found nothing that moved. SHOULD: a trailing space gives a wrong No matches (the filter did not trim, the message echoed the trimmed text). Doug chose to make the filter ignore leading and trailing spaces. That moves the head commit, so this approval becomes stale and a short fresh review of the change follows. NITs left alone: scroll-mt only helps when the browser scrolls; the 30-character cut can still clip a run of wide letters; No matches is not tab-aware (copy approved); reopened calendar shows the current month; counter text has no word date for screen readers.

Fresh independent reviewer on the last change cfeeaac (search ignores spaces at the start and end): APPROVE, no blockers, no SHOULD. It ran odd cases (non-breaking space, tab, full-width space, emoji, links that contain a space, a chip plus spaces, the Completed and Timeslots tabs), proved the three new tests fail on the old filter in a throwaway copy, and read the docs against the code. The other 16 polish commits were approved at 73e0e2b by an earlier independent reviewer (no blockers); cfeeaac is the only change since. NITs left alone: the trim rule exists in two files; no unit test for spaces plus a chip (checked in the browser).

interventions.why: Doug answered yes to three small behavior changes: each carousel date opens with its first time slot showing; a search with no hits says No matches for the text plus a Clear search button; the calendar pop-up closes after a date is picked.
Doug chose text after 9 dates for the carousel date dots (shows N of M with more than 9 dates; dots stay as today up to 9). Not shrunk, not scrolled.

Doug said yes: the schedule search ignores spaces at the start and end of what is typed (found by the independent reviewer: alpha followed by a space found nothing, and the new No matches message hid the space). Typing only spaces now shows the whole list.
